routes.label: Safest: low-danger quests, then rooftops (Falador, Seers', Pollnivneach, Ardougne)
routes.intent: Minimise danger first, then time. Only quests with no or trivial combat (The Writing's on the Wall, The Depths of Despair); rooftop courses whose failure damage is small or absent; Pollnivneach through 90 because it cannot fail from 85. No Wilderness, no boss-style quest fights, no Defence XP. Every step still shows its game-relative danger score and, where needed, its prep card.

routes.label: Balanced: full reachable quest block at 57, then Falador, Seers', Pollnivneach, Rellekka, Ardougne
routes.intent: Best time/danger trade-off under the owner's informed policy (no cap; every score and prep card shown). Adds the reachable Agility-XP quests whose fights are safespottable or prayer-blockable (Icthlarin's Little Helper, A Tail of Two Cats, Underground Pass, Regicide) and The Fremennik Trials (2,812.4 quest Defence XP for the zerker, Defence 16; enchanted lyre for Rellekka). Rellekka replaces Pollnivneach at 80-90 for a slightly higher rate.

steps.title: The Writing's on the Wall (Quest Month, released 3 Nov 2026)
steps.location: Starts with Betty at Land's End; visits Port Piscarilius prison
steps.rationale: Fixed 2,500 Agility XP with no required kills (the ambush is a cutscene, F-3086/F-5014) and no Defence XP, so it is safe for the Defence-50 cap. Done first, at 57, because fixed quest XP replaces the slowest training of the whole route (Falador, 57-60). Its 2,500 Thieving XP also lifts Thieving 24 to at least 26 (tools/xp.py), part of the way to Death on the Isle's Thieving 34 (DP04 option C). New content (17 days old at verification): re-check the walkthrough before release; the prison cell is teleport-blocked (F-5014).
steps.why_not_faster: Training straight through would avoid the quest's travel and walking time, but this quest has no documented damage source and its XP lands where the route's XP rate is lowest; its only danger signal is that it is under 30 days old.

steps.title: The Depths of Despair
steps.location: Great Kourend (Crabclaw Caves section is instanced)
steps.rationale: Fixed 1,500 Agility XP, no Defence XP, prerequisites already complete. The only required kill is a Sand Snake (level 36, max hit 3, safespottable along the west wall, F-5016), trivial against 48 Hitpoints. Placed at 57 with the other low-danger quest because fixed XP is worth most where training is slowest. Bring a little food: the Crabclaw stepping stones and rocks can be failed and their damage is undocumented (F-5384).
steps.why_not_faster: Skipping it saves the quest's travel time, but the 1,500 XP comes from a fight with a max hit of 3, so it adds almost no danger to the safest route.

steps.title: Icthlarin's Little Helper

requirements.name: A cat or kitten from Gertrude's Cat

steps.rationale: Fixed 4,000 Agility XP and no Defence XP (F-2061 also lists Thieving 4,500 and Woodcutting 4,000, not carried as numbers here because no fact holds them as a value). Fights: the Possessed Priest (max hit 6, Protect from Magic stops his damage, F-5029) and one apparition (max hit 6-9; protection prayers protect fully). Placed in the 57 quest block because it is the prerequisite for A Tail of Two Cats (S04), whose two lamps are the larger reward. Danger to note: once a flashback starts you cannot teleport until it ends (F-2064/F-5030); logging out is the exit. Dying also loses the cat.

steps.title: A Tail of Two Cats (both lamps into Agility)
steps.rationale: Two 2,500 XP lamps for any skill at 30+, both spent on Agility (5,000 XP); never Defence (the build forbids it, and the owner's Defence 1 is below 30 anyway). No required kills (F-2071). Done straight after Icthlarin's Little Helper while the cat and desert travel are fresh. Items: 5 death runes, a chocolate cake (buy it to avoid the Cooking 50 route) and a cat (F-2069).

steps.title: Underground Pass
steps.location: West Ardougne to the Underground Pass (whole quest instanced)

requirements.name: A bow and 1-5 non-poisoned metal-tipped arrows (no crossbows)

steps.rationale: Fixed 3,000 Agility XP and no Defence XP (F-2045 also lists 3,000 Attack, not carried as a number). Its real value is the gate to Regicide (S06, 13,750 Agility XP). All required fights are safespottable from Ranged (owner Ranged 56): demons max hit 9, paladins 8, Kalrag 9 and blocked by Protect from Melee. The hazards are traps (up to 24 on a failed bridge jump, F-5026/F-5379) and blessed spiders that pile on after Kalrag dies (F-5024); plan full HP before bridges and Kalrag. Placed in the 57 block so Regicide's large fixed XP lands before the slow 57-60 training.

steps.title: Regicide
steps.location: Through the Underground Pass to Isafdar and Tirannwn
steps.rationale: The largest Agility reward the owner can reach today: fixed 13,750 XP, no Defence XP. Agility 56 is met (57). The required Tyras guard (level 110, max hit 15) is safespottable at the mushrooms or fought with Protect from Melee (F-5027); Isafdar traps hit 8-15 (F-5028). It sends you through the Underground Pass again, with no bank past it (F-5380). It also unlocks Tirannwn (F-2059), the first link of the long Song of the Elves / Prifddinas chain (not reachable now: Song of the Elves needs 70 in eight skills, F-2109). Placed right after Underground Pass at 57, where its XP replaces the slowest training.

steps.title: Canifis Rooftop Course, 57 to 60
steps.location: Canifis, tall tree north of the bank
steps.rationale: Alternative first course (DP01 option B). One failable gap until 64 (damage undocumented, F-3071); the best mark rate of the low courses (16-18/h, never penalised, F-4024) for an early Graceful start; free Ectophial teleport nearby (F-4093). About half Falador's XP rate, so it is not on any route.

steps.title: Falador Rooftop Course, 57 to 60
steps.location: East Falador, wall of the house east of the Mining Guild
steps.rationale: Best open course for 57-60: the next course up (Seers') needs 60. Failure damage is known and small (Hand Holds, 3-8, until 66, F-1011/F-4072) against 48 Hitpoints; city location, no aggressive monsters noted. Rate set at the low end of the fact range (fails still happen below 66).
steps.why_not_faster: Seers' can be entered from 55 with a summer-pie boost (F-4052), but boosted laps fail more (caveat on F-4052) and need a pie supply; Wilderness Agility Course (52+) is faster with tickets but is deep-Wilderness PvP on Hardcore Worlds (F-5366, F-1070), so it is never routed.

steps.title: Seers' Village Rooftop Course, 60 to 70 (no teleport)
steps.method: Seers' rooftop laps, run back from the church
steps.location: Seers' Village, wall by the bank
steps.rationale: Standard 60-70 course: bank at the start (F-4075), two failable obstacles until 79 with undocumented damage (F-3074), Rapid Heal and the church altar at the end for HP (F-5355). Planned at the no-teleport rate because the hard Kandarin diary is impossible for this zerker (Piety task needs Defence 70, F-1021/F-2621), so the Seers' bank teleport never applies; Camelot tablets land at Camelot (F-5347). Marks here buy Graceful (a full set is roughly 18.8-23.6 hours of Seers' laps, F-4025).
steps.why_not_faster: The Werewolf Agility Course (after Creature of Fenkenstrain) gives 50,000+ XP/h, but it is not in this plan: the Risk Officer keeps its veto on an unverifiable mechanic, not on danger. The deathslide fall can hit over 30, does not scale with Hitpoints and can exceed current HP (F-2091/F-3067), and its maximum is unpublished, so no safe-HP rule can be written. It returns when the veto lifts (see assumptions). The Hallowed Sepulchre needs Sins of the Father, which the owner cannot start (F-2100), and opens only at 77.

steps.title: Pollnivneach Rooftop Course, 70 to 80
steps.location: Pollnivneach, basket north-west of the bar
steps.rationale: Fastest open rooftop at 70. Only the market stall can be failed (floor(HP/17+2) = 4 at 48 HP, F-3075) and nothing fails from 85 (F-4069). No desert heat in town (F-3076); town NPCs are not aggressive to combat 45 (jackals only to 42 or below, F-3077). Reach it by Ali Morrisane's carpet from Shantay Pass (F-1032); never walk south of town (aggressive level-63 crocodiles, F-4084). The redirected Pollnivneach tablet needs a Nightmare Zone scroll (F-4079/F-4080), and NMZ is unsafe on Hardcore Worlds, so do not use it.
steps.why_not_faster: Werewolf (50,000+ XP/h) is vetoed until its deathslide maximum is published or the never-fail stats are reached (see assumptions); Dorgesh-Kaan (50,000-63,000) fails even at 99 for about 10 damage and its quest requirements are not in the verified facts; Seers' is slower (40,000).

steps.title: Pollnivneach Rooftop Course, 80 to 90
steps.rationale: Safest course for 80-90: from 85 no Pollnivneach obstacle can fail (F-4069/F-5370), so the course itself has no damage source for the last five levels before Ardougne. Mark rate falls to 20% at 90 (F-4018), when the route moves on anyway.
steps.why_not_faster: Rellekka (80+) is slightly faster (50,000-55,052 XP/h vs 47,000-51,000) but its tightrope fails until 85, it has no bank, and the run there is not fully researched (F-5345); the difference does not justify extra uncertainty on the safest route.

steps.title: The Fremennik Trials (quest Defence for the zerker; enchanted lyre for Rellekka)

requirements.name: Lyre: craft it (Fletching 25, Woodcutting 40, Crafting 40) or get the 1/17 drop from the level 48 citizens; the owner uses the drop
Fight Koschei with no armour, weapons or spells

steps.rationale: 2,812.4 Agility XP plus 2,812.4 Defence XP that cannot be declined (F-2038): this is exactly the quest-sourced Defence the owner's zerker plan wants, taking Defence from 1 to 16 (tools/xp.py), far under the 50 cap. No hard skill requirements if the lyre is taken as a drop from the level 48 citizens (max hit 6, non-aggressive, F-5383). Fights: Draugen (max 7) and Koschei (max 3/5/7, then 1); only Koschei's 4th form is a safe death on Hardcore Worlds (F-0004/F-3014), forms 1-3 are run-ending. Placed in the 57 quest block so its Agility XP lands during the slowest training, and so the enchanted lyre (Rellekka teleport, F-4086) is ready when Rellekka opens at 80.

steps.title: Rellekka Rooftop Course, 80 to 90
steps.rationale: Fastest open course for 80-90 on the balanced route. Only the first tightrope fails, until 85, for floor(HP x 0.10) = 4 at 48 HP (F-3079/F-4070). Rellekka has no bank (F-4087); bring what you need. With The Fremennik Trials done (S12) the enchanted lyre teleports here (F-4086); otherwise a Camelot tablet and a long run north (F-5343).

steps.title: Ardougne Rooftop Course, 90 to 99
steps.location: East Ardougne marketplace, beams by the gem stall
steps.rationale: The best rooftop course and the finish for every route. Gaps 1 and 2 fail until 95 (damage undocumented, F-3080); church altar for Rapid Heal and market food nearby (F-5357). Marks stack on one tile (F-4026), so missed marks are not lost. Do not touch the Wilderness lever in East Ardougne (F-4091).
steps.why_not_faster: The Hallowed Sepulchre floors 4-5 (73,000-98,500 XP/h) need Sins of the Father, which is out of reach and pending research (DP07 option B is the long-term goal); Werewolf's 80+ ceiling (68,600) barely beats Ardougne and the course stays vetoed until its deathslide maximum is published or the never-fail stats are reached.

steps.title: Death Plateau (secret path; prerequisite for Troll Stronghold)

requirements.name: 60 coins (1,000 for the dice), 10 bread, 10 cooked trout, iron bar, Asgarnian ale

steps.rationale: No Agility XP itself (3,000 Attack only); it exists in this plan only as the gate to Troll Stronghold (DP03). Use the secret path from Tenzing's house: the normal path is multi-combat with thrower trolls whose attacks always hit (F-5374); the plateau holds aggressive named trolls hitting 23-30 (F-5375).

steps.title: Troll Stronghold (2,000 Agility XP since 3 Nov 2026)
steps.rationale: 2,000 Agility XP added in Quest Month (F-0029). Required kills: Dad (101, max 27, safespot at the western gate, F-5017), one of several aggressive Troll generals (113, max 38: two hits exceed 48 HP, F-5018) and, at Thieving 24, Berry and Twig (71, max 13, safespot from a cell, F-5019). The owner's 57 Agility uses the rock shortcuts (41-47) that avoid the thrower trolls entirely (F-5376). Offered only as a decision-point option.

steps.title: Troll Romance
steps.rationale: 8,000 Agility XP (F-2032 also lists 4,000 Strength, not carried as a number). The required Arrg fight is the problem: level 113, 38 melee / 30 accurate ranged, occasionally through protection prayers, attacks the moment you arrive, and the wiki says it is not a safe death even for Hardcore Ironmen (F-2036/F-5021); on Hardcore Worlds it is run-ending (F-5003). Decision-point option only; not recommended at 48 Hitpoints.

steps.title: Druidic Ritual (prerequisite for Recruitment Drive)
steps.rationale: Gate to Recruitment Drive (DP04 option B). Only an avoidable level 19 suit of armour; the dungeon route passes level 22/25 skeletons (F-2016). Unlocks Herblore.

steps.title: Black Knights' Fortress (prerequisite for Recruitment Drive)
steps.location: Black Knights' Fortress, north of Falador

requirements.name: 12 quest points (the owner has 36 quests done)

steps.rationale: Gate to Recruitment Drive. No required kills (evade the level 33 Black Knights). Its two 1,000 XP combat lamps (added 3 Nov 2026) can be put into Defence: never do that on this build. Prayer is entered as a placeholder; the owner may choose any listed non-Defence skill.

steps.title: Recruitment Drive
steps.rationale: 1,000.5 Agility XP (F-2010 also lists Prayer and Herblore 1,000.5, not carried as numbers). Sir Leye (level 20, max hit 3) is fought with no armour or food and is not a safe death (F-5004/F-5015); the yellow portal at each test room's start is the documented exit. Three quests for 1,000.5 Agility XP, so it is a decision-point option only.

steps.title: Death on the Isle (needs Thieving 34)
steps.rationale: 7,500 Agility XP, no Defence (F-2502 also lists Thieving 10,000 and Crafting 5,000). Blocked by Thieving 34 (owner 24; at least 26 after The Writing's on the Wall). The Thieving training is the owner's choice and is not sized here (no verified Thieving-rate facts in this job). Its two fights are scripted to stop before death per the wiki (Adala max hit 4), but you enter with no food or teleports (F-5363) and there is no Hardcore Worlds safe exception (F-5037).

steps.title: Hallowed Sepulchre, Floors 1-4, 77 to 99 (needs Sins of the Father)
steps.rationale: Highest Agility XP rates in the game for this range (73,000-81,000 XP/h to Floor 4; Floor 4 needs 77 since 12 Aug 2026, boostable, F-0018/F-0020). Not reachable now: it needs Sins of the Father (F-1054), which is far out of reach (F-2100) and is removed from this plan until its fights are researched (veto basis insufficient_facts_for_prep, see assumptions). Approved with conditions as a long-term goal (DP07 option B): Sins of the Father first and 70+ Hitpoints. Even when reachable: the wiki recommends 70+ Hitpoints (owner 48, F-3056), trap damage is undocumented (F-3057), a death is an ordinary official death (F-3003/F-3061), Darkmeyer has Vyrewatch Sentinels (151, max 17, F-3062), and the Sepulchre gives no marks of grace (F-1061).

steps.title: Seers' Village Rooftop Course, 70 to 80 (stay on Seers')
steps.rationale: DP06 option B: keep the familiar course with the bank at the start instead of travelling to the desert. Fails stop at 79 (F-1018) and marks drop to 20% at 80 (F-4018). Planned at the same 40,000 XP/h as 60-70 (the fact's range is for 60-70; later laps are faster once fails stop, so this is conservative).

assumptions: Start: Agility 57 with 212,733 XP (Hardcore Worlds hiscores, brief). Hiscores refresh on logout, so in-game XP may be slightly higher; the calculator starts from 212,733.

XP/h choices inside fact ranges (low end unless noted, because the owner plays semi-attentively and the rates include fails): Canifis 14,000 (F-1004: 14,000-19,700); Falador 27,200 (F-1010: 27,200-35,000); Seers' 40,000 (F-1017 no-teleport 40,000-44,000; its caveat warns that laps while still failing at 60-65 may be slower, 27,000-37,000); Pollnivneach 47,000 (F-1028 no diary 47,000-51,000); Rellekka 50,000 (F-1035 no diary 50,000-55,052); Ardougne 66,000 (F-1041: 66,000-70,184); Sepulchre to Floor 4: 73,000 (F-1058: 73,000-81,000).
Seers' 70-80 (S26, decision-point option only) uses the 60-70 figure of 40,000 (F-1017); this is an extrapolation and probably conservative because fails stop at 79.
Per-lap XP: Pollnivneach 890 and Rellekka 780 are the no-diary values (F-1027, F-1034). The owner has no achievement diaries (brief), so diary variants are never used.
The hard Kandarin diary is impossible for this zerker (Piety task needs Defence 70, F-1021/F-2621), so Seers' is planned without the Seers' bank teleport; Camelot tablets land at Camelot (F-5347).

Quest steps have no est_hours because no verified fact gives quest durations, so the calculator counts 0 hours for every quest: route totals understate the real time of quest-heavy routes (the balanced route).

Defence (cap 50, build profile): only The Fremennik Trials adds Defence on any route (2,812.4, F-2038), taking the balanced route to Defence 16 (tools/xp.py); the safest route adds 0. All other routed quests give 0 fixed Defence XP (cited per step). Every lamp or tome in this plan is assigned to Agility or a non-Defence skill; the Black Knights' Fortress, Graveyard and similar combat lamps must never go to Defence. Monkey Madness I's Daero training (35,000 or 20,000 Defence) is not part of any route (F-2085).

Thieving: Thieving 24 is at least 7,028 XP; with The Writing's on the Wall's 2,500 Thieving XP (F-0032) it is at least 9,528 XP = level 26 (tools/xp.py). Death on the Isle's Thieving 34 (20,224 XP) still needs training.

Secondary quest XP that no fact holds as a numeric value is named in step rationales but not carried as xp_rewards numbers: Icthlarin's Little Helper (Thieving 4,500, Woodcutting 4,000; F-2061), Underground Pass (Attack 3,000; F-2045), Troll Romance (Strength 4,000; F-2032), Recruitment Drive (Prayer and Herblore 1,000.5; F-2010), Death on the Isle (Thieving 10,000, Crafting 5,000; F-2502), and the eight unnamed non-Agility, non-Defence skills of The Fremennik Trials (F-2038). Each of those facts confirms 0 (or, for The Fremennik Trials, the carried 2,812.4) Defence XP, so the Defence-cap tracking is complete.

The Graveyard (Master quest) and its Agility course are scheduled for 25 Nov 2026 and are NOT released (F-0052, F-1113, F-2611): never a step here. Even on release the owner would need Sailing 65 (30), Agility 65, Woodcutting 56 (40), Fletching 54 (9), Olaf's Quest and The Fremennik Exiles (F-2614). Its projected course rates (55,000-75,000 XP/h, F-1115) are pre-release, and its two 75,000 XP lamps offer Defence, which must never be chosen (F-2615).
Wilderness PvP is live on Hardcore Worlds (F-5366); the Wilderness Agility Course (levels 50-56, singles-plus, no x-logging) is never routed (F-1070, F-3023, F-3011).
Random events are an unsafe death on Hardcore Worlds (F-0003); long rooftop sessions should be broken up and HP kept high.

The Colossal Wyrm course (obstacles never fail, Children of the Sun done) is not routed: after the 12 Aug 2026 rework no verified per-lap XP exists (F-0025; F-1048 is DISPUTED), so the calculator cannot size it. RFI raised.
Marks of grace and the Graceful outfit (260 marks, F-1121) are not modelled in XP rates; they improve run energy but rooftops need no stamina potions (F-4033).

Content under 30 days old in this plan: The Writing's on the Wall (3 Nov 2026), Troll Stronghold's new 2,000 XP, Black Knights' Fortress lamps (3 Nov 2026) and the Hardcore Worlds rules (4 Nov 2026). Treat them as volatile.

Long-term next step 1 (vetoed, removed from steps): Werewolf Agility Course, 60-90 (former S23; 50,000-65,000 XP/h at lower levels, F-1065), with Creature of Fenkenstrain (former S22), which gives no Agility XP (F-2095) and only unlocks the course (Ring of Charos, F-1063/F-2092). Veto basis: unverifiable_mechanic, not danger. The deathslide fall's maximum damage is unpublished: it can hit over 30, does not scale with Hitpoints and can exceed current HP (F-2091, F-3067), so the guide cannot say at what HP a fall is survivable. The veto lifts when EITHER (A) the owner has Agility 81+, Strength 81+ and carries under 2 kg (the Risk Officer's lift condition; F-3068 gives the never-fail point as Agility 80, Strength 80, 2 kg or less; owner Strength 32), OR (B) a source publishes the deathslide maximum and the Risk Officer re-rates the step with a minimum-HP rule above it. Then re-add both steps and re-run the calculator.

Long-term next step 2 (vetoed, removed from steps): Sins of the Father (former S24), the only way into the Hallowed Sepulchre (F-1054; S25, DP07 option B) and the source of a 6 x 15,000 XP tome that can all go to Agility (F-2102). Veto basis: insufficient_facts_for_prep, not danger. Its fights (F-2105) were not researched for max hits and teleport/instance rules, and the final boss's maximum is disputed, so no bail-out can be written from verified facts. It needs Woodcutting 62, Fletching 60, Crafting 56, Agility 52, Attack 50, Slayer 50 and Magic 49, none boostable (F-2100), plus A Taste of Hope and its prerequisite quests (F-2101). The veto lifts when, as the owner nears those requirements, an RFI researches its fights and the Risk Officer completes its prep card and re-rates it at the owner's stats then. The Sepulchre also needs 70+ Hitpoints (recommended, F-3056).
Danger scores are game-relative (The Fractured Archive = 100; Wilderness +25)

prerequisite_checklist.item: Cat or kitten (Gertrude's Cat) for Icthlarin's Little Helper and A Tail of Two Cats
Chocolate cake (buy) and 5 death runes for A Tail of Two Cats
Bow and 1-5 non-poisoned metal-tipped arrows for Underground Pass
Food for Falador/Seers' fails and the Crabclaw Caves obstacles; Rapid Heal (Prayer 22) for natural regeneration
Escape crystal: one free at start, more for 10,000 coins (does not activate while moving)
Coins for the Shantay Pass carpet to Pollnivneach (from 200 coins per trip)

decision_points.question: Which course for 57 to 60, before Seers' opens at 60?

options.title: Falador Rooftop Course
options.justification: About twice Canifis's XP rate (27,200-35,000 vs 14,000-19,700 XP/h) with small, documented failure damage (3-8 on the Hand Holds until 66).
pros: Fail damage known and small against 48 HP
City course, no aggressive monsters noted
cons: Fails until 66
Fewer marks than Canifis (9.7-12.1/h)

options.title: Canifis Rooftop Course
options.justification: Best marks of grace per hour of the low courses (16-18/h, never penalised), so it starts the Graceful set early, but at roughly half the XP rate.
pros: Bank at the course, free Ectophial teleport nearby
Only one failable gap, stops failing at 64
cons: About half Falador's XP/h
Failure damage not documented
options.best_for: Owners who want Graceful before Seers'

decision_points.recommendation_reason: Only three levels remain before Seers'; Falador gets there far sooner with a known, small damage source. Graceful marks come later at Seers', Pollnivneach and Ardougne.

decision_points.question: Do the reachable Agility-XP quests now, and which ones?
decision_points.conditions: Every option here gives 0 Defence XP except The Fremennik Trials (2,812.4, Defence 1 to 16), which stays far under the cap of 50.

options.title: Only the no-combat / trivial-combat quests (The Writing's on the Wall, The Depths of Despair)
options.justification: 4,000 fixed Agility XP with no documented damage source except a max-hit-3 snake; the Thieving XP also moves Thieving toward Death on the Isle's 34.
cons: Leaves the bigger Regicide reward (13,750) for later

options.title: Full reachable quest block (A + Icthlarin's Little Helper, A Tail of Two Cats, Underground Pass, Regicide, The Fremennik Trials)
options.justification: All fixed or lamp Agility XP the owner can reach today, plus quest-sourced Defence for the zerker. Every required fight is safespottable or blocked by protection prayers, and the XP lands where training is slowest (Falador, 57-60).
pros: Adds the 4,000 + 5,000 (lamps) + 3,000 + 13,750 + 2,812.4 Agility XP of the cited rewards; combined effect is in the calculator output
Quest Defence (Defence 16) from The Fremennik Trials, per the owner's zerker plan
Regicide unlocks Tirannwn; the lyre teleports to Rellekka at 80
cons: Hours of questing that the calculator does not count (no verified quest durations)
Underground Pass traps up to 24 and spider pile-ups; Icthlarin flashbacks block teleports; Koschei forms 1-3 are not safe deaths
options.best_for: The balanced route and the owner's quest-based zerker build

options.title: Skip quests for now; rooftops only
options.justification: Training alone has the simplest danger profile; the quests stay available and can be done at any level because their XP is fixed.
cons: Fixed XP is worth more time now (slowest training) than later
No quest Defence progress

decision_points.recommendation_reason: The owner optimises for balance and builds Defence only through quests; option B gives the most fixed XP where it saves the most training time, with fights that can all be safespotted or prayed against. Underground Pass and Regicide carry full prep cards (risk.json) and the owner has already accepted both; choose A for the lowest-danger quest set.

decision_points.question: Do the Troll quests (Death Plateau, Troll Stronghold, Troll Romance)?
decision_points.conditions: The owner's 57 Agility already uses the Trollheim rock shortcuts (41-47) that avoid the multi-combat thrower trolls.

options.title: Skip the Troll quests for now; keep training
options.justification: The required fights hit 27-38 (Dad, Troll generals, Arrg) against 48 Hitpoints for only 2,000 + 8,000 Agility XP of fixed rewards.
pros: Avoids the two most dangerous fights in the quest list
cons: Leaves 10,000 fixed Agility XP, 4,000 Strength XP and three quest completions unclaimed for now

options.title: Death Plateau and Troll Stronghold only
options.justification: 2,000 Agility XP (new in Quest Month); Dad and the southern-most Troll general can be safespotted with Ranged, and Berry/Twig from a cell.
pros: Safespots documented for every required kill
Thrower trolls avoided by the 57-Agility shortcuts
cons: Several aggressive Troll generals (max 38) share the room; two hits exceed 48 HP
Only 2,000 Agility XP
options.best_for: Owners who want the quest points and unlock now

options.title: All three, including Troll Romance
options.justification: Adds 8,000 Agility XP and 4,000 Strength XP from Troll Romance (F-2031, F-2032). Allowed under the informed policy: the Risk Officer approves it with conditions and a full prep card. Arrg is aggressive on arrival, hits up to 38 melee / 30 ranged, occasionally through protection prayers, and is not a safe death (F-2036, F-5021, F-5003); the run from the arena centre to the safespot is the one window where two unblocked hits can exceed 48 HP (risk.json).
pros: 4,000 Strength XP and the quest completion
Documented safespots and a prep card (48/48 HP, full prayer, Protect from Missiles on before talking to Arrg)
cons: Arrg is the most dangerous required fight in this plan (F-5003)
Not a safe death even for Hardcore Ironmen
For the Agility goal alone, 8,000 XP saves less time than the quest takes (risk.json necessity: optional)
options.best_for: Owners who want the Troll quests and the Strength XP, after Troll Stronghold has shown they can hold a protection prayer and eat under fire

decision_points.recommendation_reason: For the Agility goal alone the Troll rewards are small next to the fights, so A is recommended. B and C are allowed under the informed policy with their prep cards (the owner already accepted Troll Stronghold); choose C if the quest completions and Troll Romance's 4,000 Strength XP matter to you, and do B first so the Troll Stronghold fights test your prayer and eating under fire before Arrg.

decision_points.question: Small or gated quest detours: Recruitment Drive chain, or train Thieving to 34 for Death on the Isle?

options.title: Skip both for now
options.justification: Recruitment Drive needs two extra quests for 1,000.5 Agility XP; Death on the Isle needs ten more Thieving levels first.
cons: Leaves the 1,000.5 and 7,500 Agility XP rewards unclaimed for now

options.title: Druidic Ritual, Black Knights' Fortress, Recruitment Drive
options.justification: Clears three quests and gives 1,000.5 Agility XP plus two 1,000 XP combat lamps (never into Defence).
cons: Sir Leye is fought with no armour or food and is not a safe death
Very little Agility XP for the time
options.best_for: Owners clearing the quest list anyway

options.title: Train Thieving to 34, then Death on the Isle
options.justification: 7,500 Agility XP plus Thieving and Crafting XP, and the wiki says its two fights cannot kill; the cost is Thieving training the plan cannot size from verified facts.
pros: Fights scripted to stop before death (wiki)
cons: Thieving 34 needed (owner 24, at least 26 after The Writing's on the Wall)
Fights with no food or teleports; no Hardcore Worlds safe exception

decision_points.recommendation_reason: Neither detour is efficient for Agility now. Take option C if Thieving reaches 34 through other play; take B only when clearing quests for their own sake.

decision_points.question: At 70: move to Pollnivneach or stay on Seers'?
decision_points.conditions: Dorgesh-Kaan (70) was considered but its quest requirements are not in the verified facts (RFI).

options.title: Pollnivneach Rooftop Course
options.justification: Faster (47,000-51,000 XP/h), only the market stall can fail (4 damage at 48 HP) and nothing fails from 85.
cons: Carpet travel from Shantay Pass; never walk south of town (crocodiles)
Pollnivneach tablets need an NMZ scroll (NMZ is unsafe on Hardcore Worlds)
options.best_for: All routes that reach 70 on rooftops

options.title: Stay on Seers' to 80
options.justification: Familiar course with the bank at the start; fails stop at 79.
cons: Slower (planned 40,000 XP/h)
Marks drop to 20% at 80

decision_points.recommendation_reason: Pollnivneach is faster and its only failable obstacle has a known 4-damage hit, so it is at least as safe as Seers'.

decision_points.question: Work toward the Hallowed Sepulchre (Sins of the Father), or stay on rooftops?
decision_points.conditions: Floor 4 needs 77 and Floor 5 87 since 12 Aug 2026 (boostable). Sins of the Father needs Woodcutting 62, Fletching 60, Crafting 56, Slayer 50, Attack 50 and Magic 49 plus five quests.

options.title: Stay on rooftops (Pollnivneach / Rellekka, then Ardougne)
options.justification: Reachable now, low failure damage, marks of grace for Graceful.
cons: Lower XP/h than the Sepulchre (47,000-66,000 vs 73,000+)

options.title: LONG-TERM goal: Hallowed Sepulchre runs to Floor 4 (after Sins of the Father)
options.justification: 73,000-81,000 XP/h to Floor 4 from 77 (F-1058), the highest rate in this range, and Sins of the Father's tome (6 x 15,000 XP) can all go to Agility (F-2102). A long-term goal, not a choice for today. Preconditions: (1) Sins of the Father researched and completed: the Sepulchre needs it (F-1054), and the quest needs Woodcutting 62, Fletching 60, Crafting 56, Attack 50, Slayer 50 and Magic 49 plus A Taste of Hope and its chain (F-2100, F-2101). Sins of the Father (former S24) is pending research: it is vetoed for insufficient facts to prepare (its fights' max hits and teleport rules are unresearched) and lifts when its fights are researched as the owner nears the requirements. (2) 70+ Hitpoints recommended for the traps (F-3056; owner 48). The Sepulchre itself is approved with conditions.
pros: Highest Agility XP/h available in the 77-99 range
Sins of the Father's tome adds 90,000 Agility XP (F-2102)
cons: Not reachable now: six skills, five quests and the Sins of the Father research come first
Trap damage undocumented; 70+ HP recommended (owner 48)
Darkmeyer Vyrewatch (max 17 without vyre noble robes); no marks of grace
options.best_for: The owner's long-term next step once the account's other skills near Sins of the Father's requirements

decision_points.recommendation_reason: Option A is what this account can do today. Keep option B as the long-term goal: when Woodcutting, Fletching, Crafting, Attack, Slayer and Magic near Sins of the Father's requirements, ask for its fights to be researched (this lifts the veto), complete it, reach 70+ Hitpoints, then move to the Sepulchre from 77.

decision_points.question: At 80: Rellekka or stay on Pollnivneach?

options.title: Stay on Pollnivneach to 90
options.justification: Nothing can fail from 85, so the last five levels before Ardougne have no damage source on the course; known travel.
cons: Marks fall to 20% at 90

options.title: The Fremennik Trials (if not done) and Rellekka
options.justification: Higher XP/h and marks; the tightrope fails only until 85 for 4 damage; the quest gives the owner quest-sourced Defence and the lyre teleport.
pros: Quest Defence 2,812.4 and the enchanted lyre
cons: No bank in Rellekka
Route from Camelot partly unresearched
Koschei forms 1-3 are not safe deaths

decision_points.recommendation_reason: For the owner's balanced goal Rellekka is the faster course with the same small fail damage, and The Fremennik Trials doubles as quest Defence for the zerker. Choose A for the lowest-danger finish.
